data.message: Individual opt-in, not unanimity: I commit to 18 tons; I invite each of the other 24 to choose 18. If fulfilled, that's $8,000 more than 10. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gain; other catches need recalculation. Intentions aren't binding. Fisher24/Fisher05, please help recruit. Each person: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
